span.label: how much plastic enters the world's rivers, lakes and oceans each year, and whether any combination of the mitigation strategies now being adopted can bring that number down by 2030
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: what level of effort in waste reduction, waste management and environmental recovery would be needed to hold emissions below a stated target, given projected growth
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a mechanistic model over 173 countries showing that 19 to 23 Mt entered aquatic ecosystems in 2016, that the world's existing ambitious commitments still leave 20 to 53 Mt/year in 2030, and that no single strategy reaches the target alone
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: prediction
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a flux whose measured size depends entirely on where the boundary of `the environment` is drawn - an order of magnitude between emissions to the ocean and emissions to aquatic ecosystems
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a distance-based probability function over spatially explicit waste generation and downhill flow accumulation, applied to 173 countries stratified by World Bank income status, with a Monte Carlo simulation propagating parameter uncertainty
span.term: a distance-based probability function over spatially explicit waste generation and downhill flow accumulation, applied to 173 countries stratified by World Bank income status, with a Monte Carlo simulation propagating parameter uncertainty
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: no environmentally acceptable level of plastic emission has ever been defined, so the paper sets its target to the 2010 ocean figure - chosen because that number galvanized global action. Every statement of the form `the effort required to reach the target` is therefore an effort required to return to a past level, not to a safe one, and the authors say so in the sentence that adopts it
span.term: a target with no threshold behind it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: river emissions to the ocean run 0.8 to 2.7 Mt/year; emissions to aquatic ecosystems run 19 to 23. The difference is not measurement, it is whether a lake or a river is a destination or a conduit - and two papers using the same data can disagree tenfold without either being wrong
span.term: the boundary is worth an order of magnitude
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: reduction alone needs an 85% cut in waste generation across all income levels; waste management alone needs 99% of plastic waste managed in every country; recovery alone needs 85% of annual emissions pulled back out. Each is stated as a single number, and each is what makes the combined 40/35/25, 99/80/60, 40% package the paper's actual finding
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the G7 charter, the EU strategy, UNEP, Clean Seas and the Our Oceans conferences generally lack specific numerical targets and not all countries have made commitments, so the ambitious scenario had to be built by applying reduction targets by income band. THE MODEL'S INPUT IS AN INTERPRETATION OF POLICY, because policy did not supply a number
span.term: commitments without numbers cannot be modelled
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: waste trade is not counted, primary microplastics are not counted, lost fishing gear is not counted, the informal sector is not counted. The authors state the values may be an underestimate - and every named omission is an input, not an output, so the direction of the bias is knowable even where its size is not
span.term: the excluded flows all point the same way
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
